name: Crystal Mask of the Elan
body:
Aura moderate clairsentience; ML 7th; Slot head;; Price 10,000 gp; Weight 1/2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This crystal mask amplifies the wearer’s innate sense of the ebb and flow of psionic energy. The wearer of a crystal mask of the elan can make Spellcraft checks with a +5 competence bonus. This bonus increases to +10 if the wearer is an elan.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must have 10 ranks in Spellcraft; Cost 5,000 gp
